A very beautiful hotel in Pai.
A cafe in Pai with French crepes and carrot cake; they hold pottery lessons.

Noodles and pad thai in Pai.

A very beautiful viewpoint near Doi Miang.

The Royal Project shop: vegetables and fruit with fewer chemicals, macadamia honey and more; you can have tea with buns, and the quiet second floor is comfortable for sitting and working. Nearby are an organic cafe, a spice shop and a market.
One of the best organic shops, with great prices on vegetables and fruit, next to Royal Project Kitchen; best to come in the morning.

A cafe with a huge selection of board games for all ages, a place to hide from the heat; the owner Stuart once held a Saturday for kids (11:00–15:00). Next door is a bakery with some of the tastiest sandwiches in town.
An organic cafe; on Instagram they ran a game with a free drink for guessing the weight of the bananas in baskets.
A coffee shop with unusual signature drinks; this season's novelty is inspired by Monet and is called the most unique coffee in Thailand.

items.d: Just good coffee in Hang Dong; Oshin Bakery is next door.

items.d: A bakery in Hang Dong next to the Black single coffee coffee shop.

A New Year's evening by the Ping River welcoming 2027 at the Cross Chiang Mai Riverside hotel.

items.d: A print shop where a subscriber made copies of documents; the owner gives out stickers with his cat.

A seasonal panoramic terrace on the roof of the Parc Borough City Resort hotel with a 360° view and Doi Suthep, beautiful at sunset; wine, beer, whisky and European dishes.

items.h: in November Fri–Sun; from December daily

items.d: A fair at Kad Farang near Rimping: warm clothes are sometimes sold there on Wednesdays, and Indian food is now sold there permanently.
Thick Greek yogurt made fresh to order, with no preservatives, thickeners or fillers; pre-order 1–2 days ahead.

A fine dining restaurant in Hang Dong (more than 15 years old) with a seasonal tasting menu of Northern Thai ingredients in the Scandinavian style; listed in the Michelin guide and Tatler Spotlight 2026. Booking is advisable.
A very atmospheric cafe with foot massage and a beautiful view; the massage is not on the menu, you need to walk around the cafe and go up the stairs at the back.

items.p: 3 kg — 450 ฿, 10 kg — 1 000 ฿; free delivery (3 kg within 15 km, 10 kg — 30 km)

items.d: An atmospheric coffee shop promoted by bloggers; the author did not like it very much before the renovation, but the atmosphere is there.
A festival of coffee, roasting and tea on November 6–8: coffee shops, roasters and tastings.

items.n: Food & Fun: The 6th Food & Music Festival
items.d: A food festival on November 5–10: more than 70 participants, local dishes, sweets and live music.
A 3 and 5 km run with the famous Butterbear bear cub.
A market with a Thai-Japanese mood on November 5–8: handmade goods, clothing, jewelry and accessories.
An art installation by the artist Vassana inspired by Lanna culture and the Long Sapao tradition; opening on November 3 at 18:00, running until November 25.
A concert by the popular Thai singer DA Endorphine; the venue opens at about 19:00.
A car exhibition with various brands on November 3–16.

A small independent coffee shop without the hype, with good coffee, friendly owners and pleasant prices; rated 4.9.
An independent coffee shop with good coffee and pleasant prices, rated 4.9 (473 reviews).
An independent coffee shop near the North Gate of the Old City with good coffee and friendly owners, rated 5.0 (661 reviews).

items.d: The continuation of the channel’s table of contents: driving and licenses, car rental, converting a license, residence certificate, border run, city districts, what to see for newcomers, Pathfinders school, Pai, onsens, coffee and matcha, temples by birth year and more.
A clinic where the author liked the quality and service when treating a virus; it has doctor-supervised IV vitamin therapy programs. Address: 88/25 Moo 3, Tawangtan, Saraphi.
items.p: promotion: 10% discount on all IV drips

items.d: A traditional Chinese medicine clinic: acupuncture, Chinese herbs and other methods; a personal recommendation from a Chinese acquaintance living in Chiang Mai.

The final concert of a festival of the bands of six international schools (CMIS, Prem, Lanna, American Pacific, Unity Concord, Panyaden), supported by the Chiangmai Philharmonic Orchestra; free entry.
The fourth annual Japanese matsuri festival: a fair with 14+ stalls, Japanese souvenirs and treats, yukata, a parade and a cosplay contest with prizes.

items.n: Chiang Mai Authentic Sky Lanterns Festival

items.d: The clinic of Dr. Chatchai Suksatit (trained at Huaqiao University and Shanghai University of TCM): acupuncture, cupping, moxa, gua sha, tuina, herbs. A personal recommendation from a Chinese acquaintance.
A Chinese medicine clinic in Ban Waen; before visiting, it is worth checking the list of procedures and the acupuncture specialist.
An alternative medicine center, mentioned in the roundup of clinics for acupuncture and Chinese medicine.
A TCM clinic: acupuncture, moxa, cupping, gua sha, Chinese herbs and tuina; the website has information about the specialists and their education.
A Chinese medicine clinic; acupuncture and cupping therapy were recommended in a local group.
An Eastern medicine clinic, a recommendation from the local community in the roundup of acupuncture places.
A TCM clinic with published information on the licenses of the facility and the specialist: acupuncture, cupping, gua sha and Chinese herbs.
A center of Chinese medicine and physiotherapy; services and prices are published on the website: acupuncture, cupping, moxa, gua sha, herbs.
A TCM clinic; the website states the specialist's education in China and Thai license. Acupuncture, cupping, gua sha, Chinese herbs.
A Chinese medicine and acupuncture clinic recommended by members of local groups; one of them noted she is very pleased with the specialist.
Chinese herbs and traditional medicine; a member of a local group said that a woman practitioner gave her acupuncture and tuina massage and selected herbs for her.
An outdoor festival: walks and runs in a pine forest, camping, music and local food; the runs are free to enter with registration.
A finance expo on November 6–8: banks, investments, insurance, special offers and seminars; this year's theme is AI Wealth Creation.

items.d: A genuine agricultural market about 30 km south of Chiang Mai: buffalo and cattle are traded, with a large flea market around it selling used goods, tools, clothes and food. Free entry.
Kathin ceremonies — the offering of monastic robes at the temples Wat Pu Loei and Wat Phra That Doi Saket.

items.d: A very pleasant place to sit; it has extended its opening hours and added a discount for the evening hours.

A sushi restaurant where, when you order a cat-shaped pudding dessert, the chefs put on a dance mini-show; the videos have gained millions of views.
A boutique hotel with colonial architecture and a tropical garden; it made the top 10 boutique hotels in Asia in the Smart Travel Asia Best In Travel 2026 ranking.
The author's favorite Indian restaurant with a very tasty masala dosa — a lentil and rice crepe with a spiced potato filling.
Bagels, pizza, breakfasts, pancakes, chicken, lunches; quiet, with a little waterfall, good for working; there's also a pool, a gym, massage and a mini library.
A sports and family space: a salt-water pool for adults and children, a playground, the Rock Gym fitness hall, Pause Spa and the In The Midst cafe.

A new center that is gradually filling up with working shops and restaurants; it is becoming a nice place for a walk.
A shop next to Lanna Garden: organic goods, handmade soap and candles, delicious ice cream and Turkish coffee.
A winter town on 20–22 November 2026: artificial snow, a snow tunnel and dome, street food, craft beer, live music; on 22 November at 23:30, a joint viewing of the Man United v Liverpool match.

The channel’s table of contents with links to themed roundups: kids’ cafes, coffee shops, vegan, breakfasts, bakeries, spas, massage, manicure, clinics, parks, campsites, appliance repair, and trips (Chiang Dao, Mon Jam, Nan, Chiang Rai, Hua Hin, Hanoi).
Pennywort (gotu kola) juice is sold at the Saturday KAD Farang market.

items.n: Banh Mi Hoa Chiang Mai บั๋นหมี่วาเชียงใหม่
items.d: A Vietnamese cafe with decent banh mi and other dishes; the author praises all the food.
A viewpoint with camping not far from the city: you can pitch a tent for 150 baht; conditions are basic and there is no hot water, but the views are very beautiful.
A magician for children’s birthdays and other festive programs.

The bus resumed service in October 2026: two loops from the airport (Left Loop and Right Loop) via Night Bazaar, Warorot Market, Tha Phae Gate, Chang Phueak, Nimman. The stop is by the Grab pickup zone; from 15 November there is a kiosk at exit No. 1 of the domestic terminal.
items.p: 50 ฿ for recent listings, 30 ฿ on the airport website

items.d: An overview of Thai spirits: from the guardians Phra Phum (spirit houses) and Kuman Thong to Phi Krasue, Phi Pop and Mae Nak Phra Khanong; why Buddhism coexists with belief in spirits in Thailand.
A relatively new Greek restaurant; fans of Turkish and Greek cuisine are delighted.
A program for teenagers aged 12–18: online learning with mentors and subject specialists, an in-person space for socializing, British and American tracks (IGCSE, A-Levels, US High School Diploma).

items.n: Alstonia blossoms: a spicy smell in the evenings
items.d: In October–November a spicy, anise-like smell can be sensed on the streets in the evening: this is the alstonia (Alstonia scholaris, พญาสัตบรรณ) in bloom. For Northern Thailand it is a sign that the cool season is approaching.

items.n: ANON อานน - Artisan Pasta and Steak
items.d: A new restaurant for steak lovers, with handmade pasta.

A hotel with a view of elephants and Doi Luang Chiang Dao mountain; a SOUL accommodation type has appeared, with a bed on the upper level that lowers so you can watch the elephants without getting out of bed.

items.n: Smog in Chiang Mai: preparing for the 2027 season
items.d: PM2.5 pollution usually peaks in February–April; because of El Niño the risk of heavy smog in 2027 is higher. It is advised to buy an air purifier with a HEPA filter and N95 masks in advance, and to keep an eye on air quality.

items.n: Visa through property purchase from 3 million baht
items.d: A long-term stay program for foreigners who bought property from 3 million baht. At the beginning of October 2026 applications were suspended, but an update reports that applying is available again.
A bakery with tasty croissants with salmon and with egg filling.
An atmospheric festival: electronic music and live acts, camping, hot springs, yoga, workshops, meditations, art installations, an international community. Early Bird tickets for January 2027.
items.a: Sense Hot Spring Wellness & Spa, Mae On
items.p: camping included in the ticket price

items.d: A festival of music and art in nature on 20–22 November 2026: electronic musicians and live artists, several stages, camping.
A big 11-day festival with a music program, camping and a creative community, 28 January – 7 February 2027; held for the 15th time.
An intimate world music festival on 12–14 February 2027: handpan, didgeridoo and other ethnic instruments, art installations, workshops, evening DJ sets.
An intimate festival on 19–21 February 2027: music, art, creative workshops, local musicians and bonfire gatherings.
The first joint festival of @saltroots_, @moonworldgathering and @kadkaennoi: two days of music, art and a creative artists’ village in Pai.
A pastry shop with striking entremet (mousse) cakes; many people like it, and the low rating is mostly because of the staff.
A homemade bakery-cafe: very tasty, not greasy pastries with fillings such as cottage cheese, plus cakes; a recommendation from a subscriber.
A Telegram chat and channel about life in Vietnam, for those who find it relevant.

items.n: Le Du Kan ฤดูกาล Le Du Kan
items.d: A relatively new aesthetic restaurant next to the pastry shop Saruda Finest Pastry Espace.
A link to sign up for the free Decathlon events near Central Festival.
A newly opened restaurant.
A music event at the Pittalew Art Gallery art space in Pai on 8 November 2026; program details should be checked with the organizers.
Two events at the Baan Samadhi venue: 11–13 December 2026 and 15–17 January 2027.
A place for children and parents: archery, a trampoline, swings, rabbits, children play together; for adults an extensive menu and tasty breakfasts; workshops are held regularly.
Vegan Thai food from a wonderful hostess: a favorite vegan pad thai and tom kha soup; available on Grab.

items.n: Pad Thai Ai-Oon ผัดไทยไออุ่น
items.d: A place with delicious pad thai.
Another cleaner/cleaning service: a link to a Facebook page.
Another cleaner/cleaning service: a link to a Facebook page.

items.n: Frozen roti with egg and herbs (Makro)
items.d: A quick snack: frozen roti with egg and herbs from Makro, taken out of the freezer and fried, like homemade pies; good with guacamole or sour cream.

A series of 4 Mozart concerts by the Chiangmai Serenade String Orchestra: 20.11, 19.12.2026, 30.01 and 13.02.2027. A subscriber’s review: the price is more for the atmosphere, but classical music is worth supporting.
items.a: Sukhothai Room, Shangri-La Chiang Mai Hotel
items.p: Season pass for 4 concerts: Exclusive from 6 600 ฿, Premium 5 000 ฿, Standard 3 400 ฿, children’s (7–12) 2 000 ฿

items.d: A great place to order cakes; everything is also tasty and cozy, good for breakfasts, with plenty of pastries.
A garden restaurant on the bank of the Ping by the Khua Lek iron bridge: dishes, drinks, coffee; at weekends (Chef’s Together Weekend Garden) live saxophone from 14:00 to 15:00.
items.a: by Khua Lek Bridge, Ping River

items.d: A Facebook group where people get together to make something, listen to a podcast at the same time and then discuss it.
An art festival in the old town of Lamphun: Museum After Dark, exhibitions by masters and young authors, pop-up workshops, Moonlight Art Walk, a market of crafts and food, Full Moon Gathering.
items.a: Khum Chao Suriya, Rot Kaeo and Wang Sai streets

items.d: Floating down the Pai River on inflatable tubes with stops at bars, DJs and games up to a final party at River Chillax Bar; the 2026/27 season opens on 30 October, usually on Tuesdays and Fridays. Adults only, drinking is optional.
items.a: office: 21/1 Chai Songkhram Road, Walking Street, Wiang Tai
items.h: Tuesday and Friday, transfer around 12:30 (from Nolo Hub — 12:00)

items.d: An alternative tubing in Pai with its own route: four stops, DJs, foam fun and games; 18+. Meeting point at Revolution Hostel Pai Riverside.
items.a: Revolution Hostel Pai Riverside, Wiang Tai

items.n: NARIT Public Night — Starry Halloween x Alien Night
items.d: Free telescope observations at Sirindhorn AstroPark: Saturn, Andromeda, the Pleiades, kids’ workshops; the season opens on 31 October with a Halloween theme, then every Saturday until May 2027.
items.h: on Saturdays 18:00–22:00, from 31 October 2026 to May 2027

items.d: A nice Instagram account with housing rental offers.

items.n: YODDOI Coffee ยอดดอยม่อนแจ่ม Coffee
items.d: A nice place to start the day: good coffee and a huge swing.
A yoga space in an open wooden pavilion overlooking a garden and a water lily pond: Flow Yoga, yin yoga, qigong, sound baths, yoga with handpan; teacher Kru Ta, community events are held at times.
items.p: In the October schedule — 350 ฿ per class

items.d: A cafe with a gothic atmosphere and a large green area, an indoor hall or open zones; for rest, work or breakfast.
A small coffee shop with big windows, plants and its own roasting; for specialty coffee, reading or quiet work.
A quiet cafe by the Ping River with an almost resort-like atmosphere: coffee, pastries, dishes and Monsoon Tea.
A cafe-restaurant with wooden buildings, terraces and a view of Doi Suthep; for breakfast, a full meal or a quiet evening.
A coffee shop with an industrial interior, unusual decor and an art-space atmosphere; for work, photos and meetings.
A British-style cafe with vintage cars, a gas pump, a red phone booth, a garden and a railway; very photogenic.
A bookstore and cafe with books, posters and artworks, for coffee and reading among the shelves.

items.n: ซาวบาทsคอฟฟี่ SAAO BAHTs COFFEE
items.d: A coffee shop with affogato on homemade ice cream and americano at 20 baht each; coffee from Chiang Rai.
A budget place near the university, essentially a food court, fairly tasty; there is a Burmese tea leaf salad, a salad with rice for 50 baht.
A weekly evening of poetry and music by Tha Phae Gate: you can read your own poems, listen or just come; no tickets.
items.a: Attika Studio, 3rd floor, Rong Leuy Tha Phae, by Tha Phae Gate

items.n: Phu Win Homestay/Cafe ภูวินคาเฟ่ & บ้านพักภูวิน
items.d: A homestay and cafe in a glamping format with a very photogenic mountain view; you can stop by just for a cup of coffee.

items.n: มหัศจรรย์ ม่อนแจ่ม𝔚𝔬𝔫𝔡𝔢𝔯𝔩𝔞𝔫𝔡
items.d: A cafe next to Phu Win with the same beautiful view; flowers are blooming beautifully there now.

items.n: The Smilist Implant & Dental Clinic by HYPS
items.d: A dental clinic with maximum care and aesthetics (a pillow, a blanket, attention to the patient); a recommendation from a subscriber.
A place that makes Mycobev ginger ale with organic ginger, turmeric, lime and cane sugar, with medicinal mushroom vinegar, cordyceps and other mushrooms.

items.n: RTC city buses at the airport
items.d: From mid-November 2026 RTC Chiang Mai City Bus tickets can be bought at a kiosk in the domestic terminal and you can wait for the bus indoors; payment by card and contactless Mastercard Tap & Go, including on the bus.
A new place with a sauna, an ice bath and a cafe surrounded by greenery in Hang Dong, not far from Baan Tawai.
A group singing and vocal improvisation gathering, no vocal training needed; afterwards you can stroll around the market with a coffee and craftsmen’s stalls.
items.a: SangGaDee Space — Bamboo Family Market, San Kamphaeng

items.d: A shop of Halloween and carnival costumes; the selection can be viewed on its Facebook page. The name is not given in the post.

items.n: The Ritual: Fire & Shadow — promo code
items.d: The promo code FR10 gives 10% off tickets to The Ritual festival.
A quiet garden-like cafe whose owner speaks excellent English: breakfasts, Thai food, unusual desserts, a very tasty coconut pie. Apparently a branch of the Nimman Charin Pie (link in links).

In the Ban Phue area by Tat Noi Waterfall (Phu Hin Chom That – Phu Phra Bat protected area), 6 fossilized footprints of a predatory dinosaur about 120 million years old have been confirmed, the footprint length is 29 cm.
Small conversation meetings by level: English and Thai on Mon and Wed, Thai practice and a shared dinner on Saturdays; by prior registration only.
items.p: 150 ฿ per day or 800 ฿ per month
items.h: Mon and Wed: 17:00–18:00 English, 18:30–19:30 Thai; Sat: 16:00–17:00 Thai, 17:30–18:30 dinner

items.d: Swimming lessons for children and adults from scratch, including children afraid of water, at a gentle pace; classes at The Urbana 1, World Club or in your condo’s pool.
items.p: From 3 500 ฿ for a package of 10 classes

items.d: Rimping at Kad Farang has a fish very similar to hot-smoked mackerel (tasty with potatoes) and trendy sushi.
A vintage-style restaurant: tasty mushroom tacos, duck curry, Caesar salad.

The author’s favorite vegan cafe with gluten-free options: gluten-free Margherita pizza, cashew mac and cheese pasta, falafel with mashed potatoes, rice noodles with mushrooms and tofu, pancakes with black sesame. The owner has two more cafes.
Go Wholesale had a big choice of discounted panettone: the 800-baht ones for 350, small ones at 99 baht with a 1+1 deal; the stand is by the checkouts.

items.n: MAYA Lifestyle Shopping Center — new clothing stores
items.d: 13 clothing and accessories stores have opened on the 2nd floor of MAYA (Center Zone): Stylist, URTHE, Classy Club, CLOUDY, DRIPLAB, HOB STUDIOS, Slip to Sleep, High School, with.it, MIRR Lab, Lamobi, NATURE, LOVE Studio.

items.s: art and antiques in a garden
items.d: Once a year the hidden De Siam garden becomes an open-air gallery: art, antiques, live painting, crafts, DIY workshops, live music. At other times you can get in only as a customer.
A weekly improvisation practice: movement, stories, silence, singing and play; you don’t need to be a dancer or an actor. Led by Jori Martinez.
An organic garden cafe where InterPlay takes place; according to the author, the food is very tasty.
A weekly meetup to practice English, Thai or Chinese and meet people from different countries.
A Facebook community where people in Chiang Mai look for conversation partners to practice languages (including Russian, Czech, German, English) and to meet new people.
Every Monday at Paapu House, live classical music (violin and cello) in the atmosphere of a European salon; from 17:00 a happy hour with drinks and snacks at 99 ฿.
items.p: Happy hour: drinks and snacks at 99 ฿
items.h: every Monday, music from 19:30, happy hour from 17:00

items.d: Rooftop sunset yoga: Mon–Wed hatha, Thu vinyasa, Sat yin yoga, Sun Yoga Flow.
items.h: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Sat, Sun at 18:00

items.n: Ban Rai Kong Khing Village — fire treatment
items.d: In the village of Ban Rai Kong Khing they practice the traditional Northern Thai “fire treatment” for pain; the procedure can be dangerous and does not replace medical care. Booking is required.

A tourist electric tram with 15 stations between the city’s cultural sites, with the participation of AWC; the launch is announced for November 18, 2026, the list of stops, the schedule and prices have not been published yet.

items.n: TULOU Restaurant ภัตตาคารตูลู่
items.d: A restaurant with excellent macarons and duck.

items.n: Khao Man — a Thai hiking snack
items.d: Thai hikers take Khao Man (ข้าวมัน) into the mountains: sticky rice cooked in coconut milk with sugar and a sweet egg filling in a banana leaf — filling, energizing, compact and plastic-free.

items.n: Exhibition on the history and culture of the Shan people (Wat Ku Tao)
items.d: An exhibition about the Shan people at Wat Ku Tao: historical photos, including from the era of the Shan princes, customs, materials about the sawbwas; captions in Shan, Thai and English. Organized by the Shan Literature and Culture Association.
Group classes for puppies and owners: basic skills, manners, socialization and calmness; three age groups of 5 participants each, no experience needed.
A new beautiful hotel in Hang Dong; the reviews on the map are good, but, according to the author, the real reviews are awful.
A new hotel in Hang Dong with beautiful views and rooms with small pools; a minus: the unhappy staff spoil the impression.

A cave: it’s better to park at the fork after the dirt road and walk about 15 minutes, the cave itself takes about 10 minutes; it smells, flashlights are needed, there are bats; easy trekking, children managed it, sneakers are better.
A new children’s cafe near Takkatan Cave: slides, trampolines, a small pond with turtles and fish, climbing frames, workshops; for the water rides bring shorts and caps for the children.

Homemade farmer’s cheese (tvorog) and pancakes made with whey, without sugar and salt, gluten-free pancakes are available (rice flour + tapioca); pre-order by private message, pickup or Grab delivery at the buyer’s expense.
items.p: Cottage cheese 250 g — 150 baht; pancakes 5 large pieces — 150 baht

items.d: Yulia bakes medovik to order, whose taste reminded the guests of childhood, and other goodies (the contact is in the original post this is a reply to).
Phutawan cedar essential oil with a very pleasant smell, sold on Lazada.
A concert by Kor Natapon (vocalist of P.O.P and Groove Riders) with a full band in the open air; you can stay at the campsite.
items.p: Presale 890 ฿ (until 20 November), on the day of the event 1090 ฿; camping 500 ฿ per tent

items.n: Phu Pha Daeng Homestay ภูผาแดงโฮมสเตย์
items.d: A guesthouse near the pier on Mae Ngat lake, where boats depart from.

items.n: Barn Khong Mae (บ้านของแม่)
items.s: family cafe with a play area
items.d: A family cafe outside the city: a big playground, zipline, karting, boats, new play areas and a toy-gun shooting range; food and drinks for adults, there is an air-conditioned hall.
items.p: Zipline 150 baht per person, unlimited descents

items.d: 14 national parks are connected with the Chiang Mai region: Doi Inthanon, Doi Suthep–Pui, Mae Ping, Ob Luang, Huai Nam Dang, Si Lanna, Mae Takhrai, Khun Khan, Mae Wang, Mae Tho, Doi Pha Hom Pok, Ob Khan, Doi Wiang Pha, Pha Daeng.
A volunteer program: help students with English and live in a local community; accommodation, meals and activities are included.
A phone number to call for snakes; from a subscriber’s experience, the San Phak Wan municipality arrived at 7 a.m., and their car has the municipality’s phone number on it.
A new cafe in the Mae Jo area.
The Tops supermarket at Central — this is where subscribers found herring.
The Tops supermarket at 89 Plaza — herring can be bought here.
The Kew Mae Pan nature trail in Doi Inthanon National Park: open until May 31, 2026, then closed for the rainy season, reopening around November. It is cool at the top, 13–15°C in the morning.
items.p: National park entry for foreigners ~300 baht, children 150 baht; guide 200–220 baht per group
items.h: usually 06:00–16:00; open from 1 November to May, closed June–October

items.d: Regular saxophone performances at Half on Sundays at 18:00, in the railway park.

items.n: Chinese restaurant with a vegan menu
items.d: A Chinese restaurant with two menus on regular days, vegan and meat; during the vegan festival, soups, desserts and main dishes. The name is not given in the post.

items.n: Suki Changphuak สุกี้ช้างเผือก
items.d: A place with fried Thai sukiyaki recommended by a Taiwanese man; another subscriber calls it the best suki in Chiang Mai.
Another very tasty sukiyaki place — a small chain (two locations), with delivery via Grab; the name is not given in the post.

items.n: Doi Luang Chiang Dao: route booking
items.d: Registration for the overnight route is October 26–30, 2026 (from 08:00 to 16:00) for visits on 16.11.2026–12.02.2027, through the website only; up to 100 people a day, up to 2 per application, closed on Wednesdays, no refunds or date changes; bookings sell out instantly.
items.h: The route is closed every Wednesday

A one-day festival of wellness, music and culture: aerobics with BEBE, Vinyasa Yoga Flow with NUI, Sound Journey with DAVIDE, relaxing by the pool; tickets via the QR code on the poster or Facebook private messages.
items.p: Early Bird 900 ฿ (until 20 October), regular 1 200 ฿, at the door 1 500 ฿

items.d: A deodorant from Lazada that, according to reviews, lasts a long time and suits the Thai climate well; there is a link with free delivery.
A Russian book shop in Phuket — a link to the website.
A Thai skincare brand with active ingredients (niacinamide, vitamin C, hyaluronic acid, ceramides, retinol and retinal) at affordable prices; a subscriber praises their retinol.

items.d: A cosmetics brand on Lazada — the favorite of a subscriber who has used it for about 4 years.

An exhibition of art objects by the artist Supapong Laodheerasiri about how objects change meaning depending on the space.
A new coffee shop with a vintage store in an old building on Tha Phae Road: coffee, vintage clothing, accessories, jewelry, simple breakfasts.

items.d: Minimalist black cabins by the mountains in Chiang Dao, convenient for trekking to Doi Luang Chiang Dao; according to a review breakfast is included, the owner gave a ride to the start of the route, there is a dog on the grounds.

items.d: The official opening of WellNest by The Cocoon: pool, sauna, steam room, ice bath, music by 4TH, Samche and Swill’O, food and drinks.

items.n: Pizza Plus with Eve & Sine at Doi saket
items.d: A pizzeria with a view of the rice fields on the road from Chiang Rai: pizza, tiramisu, Tomahawk steak, cordon bleu, duck; the owner’s drawing is on the wall, a very charismatic owner.
A new Japanese place near Central Festival: gyoza, ramen, marinated salmon.

items.n: A Cup of Trees Chiang Mai
items.d: An intimate space by appointment: afternoon tea on Saturdays, private tea parties for 4 or more people, baking workshops, homemade cakes and bread to take away on the first Saturday of the month; khachapuri is planned for November.
items.p: Saturday Delight 900 ฿; Private Dessert 1500 ฿; workshop 4500 ฿ for two or 6500 ฿ individually
items.h: Saturday Delight on Saturdays 13:00–16:00; Takeaway Treats every first Saturday 11:00–16:00; Cake Day 11:00–16:00

items.d: A sports camp for kids aged 5–12: tennis or swimming, basketball, golf, rock climbing, archery, hip-hop; you can choose only the morning program.
items.p: Morning — 1 400 ฿/day or 4 000 ฿/3 days; full day — 2 500 ฿/day or 7 500 ฿/3 days

items.n: CNX Learning Camp Food Science & Math Camp

items.d: Day camps for kids aged 4–8 during the holidays: Nature Everywhere (October 19–23) and Farm Fun (October 26–30); the price includes lunch, two snacks, materials, insurance and a certificate.

A center of traditional Thai body therapy by Dr. Sirichan on the grounds of Green Oasis Resort; the approach is chosen individually, and you can have a preliminary assessment. An expat’s review about help with chronic lower back pain.

A sauna, a Thai steam room, an ice plunge and an outdoor cold shower in a garden; on Saturdays private 3-hour bookings for groups of 4 or 8 people (up to 15 — two sessions in a row), booking required.

items.d: For those who care about gluten-free: Rimping and 7-Eleven have chips made from legumes and almonds.

Dog walking services with photos during the walk and a video report; booking by direct message to the provider.

items.d: A dog-friendly cafe: tasty and normal prices.

items.d: A coffee roaster with decaf; you can also buy coffee beans to take home here.
A coffee shop from the decaf roundup: a pretty place for photos, lots of sockets, small coffee portions.
A coffee shop with its own roastery from the decaf roundup: cozy armchairs, handy for working online, a big choice of coffee.
A Thai cuisine restaurant opposite Wat Ban Fon on the Chiang Mai–Samoeng road: fried rice with salted fish and beef, beef krapow, yum woon sen, crispy garlic and shallot. Rating 4,8.
The author shows what you get for the money (details in the photos in the post).

items.n: Gotu kola: why people eat it
items.d: Gotu kola is a traditional Asian herb: according to the description it supports memory and concentration, gently calms, is good for microcirculation and leg veins and for collagen synthesis; in Ayurveda it is considered a longevity plant.
A new spacious loft space of the local roaster Roasted Flavors in an internet café / coworking format: you can come with a laptop and work for several hours.
A big Christmas fair at WILDSIDE Chiang Mai: more than 50 participants, food, drinks, sweets, gifts, handmade items, plants, music and workshops.

A restaurant at the Kantary Hills hotel: on Fridays an evening buffet with an emphasis on meat (beef, leg of lamb), salmon, pasta, pizza, cheeses and a large choice of desserts; the menu changes weekly.
items.p: 700+ baht per person (about 824 baht including fees), children under 12 -50%

items.d: A new outlet of the Thai tea brand Karun (since 1998): classic and flavored Thai tea, plant-milk options, gelato; you can choose the sweetness level down to 0%.
A new cafe, opening on November 3: the menu has healthy food from local ingredients, fruit shakes, juices and elixirs.
A shop next door to JH Kitchenware: goods for the home and handicrafts, even Christmas trees with decorations.
A place for unhurried searching for interesting small things, decor and vintage items.
A Japanese second-hand shop with extra discounts at times; the author regularly buys porcelain dishes there at very low prices.

A place near Warorot Market on several floors (there is a third one too); Turkish coffee is better ordered for several people, on the second floor there are photo props — oriental hats, embroidered scarves.

items.n: Endurance Athletic is looking for runners for a photo shoot
items.d: The brand is preparing its first collection and is looking for real runners, men and women, for a shoot of about 3 hours; no modeling experience needed, participants get a set of sportswear. The date may change.

items.n: Dentrio Dental Clinic คลินิกทันตกรรมเดนทรีโอ
items.d: A dental clinic for adults and children: while mom has her teeth treated, the kids play under supervision. Parents praise the gentle approach to children and the tact of the doctors.

items.n: WOW WIZARD OF WASH CAR DETAILING CENTER
items.d: A car wash and detailing; while your car is being washed, you can sit by the pond behind the car wash and meditate.
A small shop of woven goods made of bamboo, rattan and reed at 63 Khuangmen Rd: baskets, trays, mats, decor, a bit of furniture.
A shop of dishes and kitchen utensils at 64–66 Khuangmen Rd: wooden trays and bowls, plates, glass, ceramics, small things for the home.
A Japanese second-hand shop: lots of ceramics and dishes, furniture, interior items.
A large second-hand shop with furniture and various things for the home — for rummaging and finding something unusual.

items.n: Free Bird Donation Center & Thrift Store
items.d: A charity second-hand shop near Nimman: clothing, sometimes home items, decor and dishes.
A weekend flea market: there is sometimes furniture, interior items and various second-hand things.

items.n: Free yoga in Nong Buak Haad park
items.d: Free classes every morning on the grass by the playground between two ponds, a new teacher and style every day (hatha, kundalini, power yoga, mobility and others). You can rent a mat on site.

items.n: Excursion to Phrae: History, Heritage Houses and Handicrafts
items.d: A three-day Lifelong Learning Payap trip to Phrae: history, old houses, temples, crafts and textiles. Accommodation, transport, meals, tickets, a guide and insurance are included; single accommodation +1000 baht.
A workshop on Japanese sashiko embroidery and the traditional handicrafts of Thailand’s hill peoples, suitable for beginners.

items.n: View the Stars with Experts from NARIT Astronomy Park
items.d: An evening telescope observation with NARIT specialists: Jupiter, Mars, Venus, the rings of Saturn.

A trip to the IWP Mae Rim Retreat Center: a talk about Buddhist women leaders and activists, an introduction to the center and guided meditation. Transport, lunch and a donation to the center are included.
items.a: IWP Mae Rim Retreat Center, Mae Rim

items.d: Individual help with an iPhone or Android, 30 minutes per person; registration for a specific slot is required.

items.n: Our Life on a World Cruise
items.d: An American couple will talk about life on the Villa Vie Odyssey round-the-world liner: expenses, work, an ordinary day on the ship.

items.n: Macassar/Makassar: A Tale of Two Cities
items.d: A lecture on the history of Indonesians in South Africa, Sheikh Yusuf and Tuan Guru, and Malay identity outside Southeast Asia.
How to shoot better on an iPhone and Android, shoot motion, work with Google Photos, edit and create albums.

items.n: Many Ways of Knowing: A Biomimicry Journey
items.d: A session on biomimicry — how nature inspires science, art and philosophy, and on the difference between the Western scientific approach and the knowledge of indigenous cultures.
An informal support group on Fridays: socializing, sharing resources, a chance to talk and be heard; you can come regularly or from time to time.

The festival of a hundred thousand lanterns: lanterns decorate the temples and streets of the historic center of Lamphun, the tradition is connected with Lanna Buddhist offerings. October 1 — November 30, free entry.
A reservoir on the Chiang Mai University campus; a popular photo spot, with the mountains reflected in the water, especially beautiful at sunset.
A matcha cafe from the updated list of Chiang Mai's most stylish places of 2026.
A small art village near Wat Umong: workshops, local artists, ceramics, jewelry, wood and leather goods, cafes and creative classes.
From the selection “25 places in Chiang Mai 2026”: people come here to look at the mountain.
The heart of Pai's vibe: talks, DJs, musicians and other events; the tea, chocolate, carrot cake, Indian food and the hosts' warmth get praise. There's Turkish coffee.
From the selection “25 places in Chiang Mai 2026”, the coffee and cozy places section.
From the selection “25 places in Chiang Mai 2026”: a central spot near Tha Phae.
A new charming vintage shop with clothing and jewelry, and a very nice owner.
From the selection “25 places in Chiang Mai 2026”, the coffee and cozy places section; known for the horse that the channel has already laughed about.
From the selection “25 places in Chiang Mai 2026”: a retro atmosphere.

From the selection “25 places in Chiang Mai 2026”: a must for Instagram photos.
From the selection “25 places in Chiang Mai 2026”: you will surely find something for your kitchen here.
From the selection “25 places in Chiang Mai 2026”: signature pancakes.
From the selection “25 places in Chiang Mai 2026”: gorgeous smoothies.
From the selection “25 places in Chiang Mai 2026”: khao soi, with vegan options.
From the selection “25 places in Chiang Mai 2026”: fried noodles and fried rice with shrimp.
